title: The Relational-Thermodynamic Map (100-Entry Update) — Philosophy as Empirical Phase Space
summary: A comprehensive mapping of 100+ philosophical traditions onto a unified framework treating relational logic primitives (reflexivity, symmetry, transitivity, antisymmetry, functionality) as thermodynamic properties, yielding a "phase diagram of human rationality." Each philosophy receives a thermodynamic signature, dominant logical primitive, reistic state, and logic topology, enabling prediction of cultural evolution and belief-system error correction. The document demonstrates that meaning operates as manifold flow rather than mere cognitive computation.
compress: Five relational logic primitives, treated as thermodynamic variables, generate a complete and predictive phase diagram of all philosophical systems — and this topology is now bridged to empirical falsification through a fully specified experimental protocol that converts compressive prediction from philosophical claim to testable hypothesis with synthetic ground truth.
invariants: theoretical claims require experimental protocols to complete their epistemic status
synthetic ground truth enables falsification of substrate-independent principles
obligations: must track whether the five primitives' thermodynamic behavior survives contact with agent-architecture-level evidence

the phase diagram's predictive power must now be evaluated against the experimental protocol's metrics — if the compressive prediction framework fails empirically the thermodynamic map's foundations require revision
renorm_reason: The new knowledge materially strengthens this node by providing exactly what the relational-thermodynamic map lacked — an empirical bridge. The map claimed philosophy is empirical physics; now there exists a concrete experimental design capable of confirming or refuting that claim. This closes a genuine epistemic gap (theory without test protocol) and creates a new obligation to track experimental outcomes against the map's predictions.
